payload.body:
Fixed the Swift FrickClient.installSession fast path (packages/swift/Sources/FrickSwift/FrickClient.swift), which only checked userId + schema hash and never tenantId, so a same-user /api/tenant/switch (FR-311) re-mint left the stale-tenant cache in place and verifyCacheCompatibility then threw FrickCacheIncompatibleError(sessionScopeMismatch) on every subsequent read -- exactly the Zavro AQ-181 workaround. installSession now also compares session.tenantId against the in-memory previous session and clears cache+pending appends on a tenant change, same as it does for a userId change.

Investigated TS (packages/core/src/runtime.ts FrickClient.setSession) and Kotlin (apps/android/frick FrickClient.verifyCacheCompatibility/FrickCacheCompatibility.reason) for the same bug -- both are already correct:
- TS: sessionScope() composite key already includes tenantId, so scopeChanged already trips on a tenant-only swap and clearUserState()/#cache.clear() already fires. No code change; added a regression test isolating the tenant-only case (previously only a combined user+tenant swap was tested).
- Kotlin: has no auto-reset fast path at all -- verifyCacheCompatibility always compares persisted vs current metadata (schemaId, schemaRevision, tenantId, userId symmetrically) and throws SESSION_SCOPE_MISMATCH, leaving reset to the caller via resetCache(). Already treats tenantId and userId identically; no asymmetry to fix.

Tests added:
- Swift: packages/swift/Tests/FrickSwiftTests/FrickClientSessionSwapTests.swift -- testRestoreSessionForDifferentTenantClearsCache (tenant switch clears cache + pending appends, then verifyCacheCompatibility succeeds -- this throws FrickCacheIncompatibleError before the fix) and testRestoreSessionForSameTenantKeepsCache (same tenant, new token, cache preserved). Updated the private makeSession() helper to accept tenantId.
- TS: packages/core/tests/runtime.test.ts -- 'clears cached user state on a same-user tenant switch' (isolates tenantId-only change vs the existing combined-swap test).

Test evidence:
- pnpm test (root): 46 files / 426 tests passed, including the new TS regression test.
- pnpm typecheck (root): clean.
- swift build --target FrickSwift: clean compile of the fixed installSession.
- swift test (FrickSwiftTests) could not link on this machine: pre-existing linker failure in the FrickMacros target (missing SwiftSyntax/SwiftCompilerPlugin symbols under the installed Xcode-beta toolchain), reproduced identically on a clean vanilla-main checkout with .build wiped, i.e. unrelated to this change. Verified instead via 'swift build --build-tests', which compiles+typechecks FrickSwiftTests successfully (FrickSwiftTests.swiftmodule produced, zero errors referencing FrickClientSessionSwapTests.swift) -- only the final Ld step fails on the unrelated macro target. Follow-up: someone with a matching Xcode/toolchain should run 'swift test --filter FrickClientSessionSwapTests' to get an actual pass/fail signal before this ships to a Swift consumer.

No Rust/schema files touched, so scripts/gen-test-keys.sh / cargo test was not needed.
